description.narrative: The project will (i) continue the phased rehabilitation of Toktogul hydroelectric power plant (HPP) by replacing two of the four existing generator and turbine units and associated auxiliary equipment; (ii) implement a business process improvement project for the main generation company, open joint-stock company Electric Power Plants (EPP); (iii) prepare an asset inventory and revaluation for the seven power companies, and Bishkekteploset (heat and hot water distribution company); and (iv) prepare a power sector master plan to include a due diligence study for the rehabilitation of Uch Kurgan HPP. The project will increase domestic energy supply and international electricity trade, improve asset management and sector planning, and strengthen sector operational performance.

Reports and Recommendations of the President
EPP DSCR improved from 0.25 in 2014 to at least 1.3 in 2023.
Efficiency of Toktogul units 2 and 4 increased by 2.5 percentage points—from 90% in 2014 to 92.5 % in 2023
EPP debt–equity ratio improved from 65:35 in 2014 to 70:30 in 2025
Grant 0419: 96% of contracts awarded and 90% disbursed as of 03 Jul 2025
Loan 3212: 91% of contracts awarded and 87% disbursed as of 03 Jul 2025
Loan 8306: 66% of contracts awarded and 61% disbursed as of 03 Jul 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: To help SCIESU in preparing a comprehensive Power Sector Master Plan (PSMP), ADB engaged consultants to prepare the Energy Sector Concept in providing the medium to long term policy objectives required to guide the detailed implementation of the same. A final report was submitted in Oct 2017. The Terms of Reference for PSMP consultant was finalized by SCIESU in Sep 2018, where the selection is to be advertised in Oct 2018.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jun 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/46348/46348-003-apfs-en_17.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Power Sector Master Plan Consultant Terms of Reference was discussed with all energy agencies in April 2016 and further refined in Nov 2017. Three individual consultants were fielded and recommendations for strategy work were submitted (Oct 2017). TOR was finalized by SCIESU in Sep 2018 and expected to be advertised in Oct 2018.
Consultant is yet to be engaged while EPC contractor is yet to be procured
